details.description: Sony's PlayStation 5, streamed from the console over Remote Play. Each file is a tile for a game; launching opens the Remote Play client, the game itself is picked on the PS5 dashboard.

emulators.name: Standalone CloudPad (Remote Play)
emulators.description: Supported extensions: ps5. Opens CloudPad on its console list; the Remote Play protocol cannot start a specific game.

emulators.name: Standalone Pylux (Remote Play)
emulators.description: Supported extensions: ps5. Opens Pylux on its console list; the Remote Play protocol cannot start a specific game.
